seasons.melt_out_note: no date: the sensor kept a reading on bare ground

facts.text: Snow had already left West Woodchuck Meadow (9,100 ft) when this year's record begins on April 1, at least 55 days earlier than the midpoint of two of the three earlier seasons on file (2024 and 2025).

evidence.name: West Woodchuck Meadow
evidence.detail: already bare on April 1; earlier seasons: May 19 (2024), May 30 (2025); 2023: the sensor kept a reading on bare ground

facts.text: At Blackcap Basin (10,180 ft), this year's highest snow water on or after April 1 was 20.6 in, the second highest of three of the four seasons on file (2024 to 2026).

evidence.name: Blackcap Basin
evidence.detail: 20.6 in on May 1; earlier seasons: 43.5 in (2024), 5.8 in (2025)

facts.text: An estimate: snow left the pass itself between May 15 and July 11, carried from the melt-out dates at Blackcap Basin (10,180 ft) and Bishop Pass (11,200 ft) to the pass elevation.

evidence.name: Blackcap Basin
evidence.detail: melted out May 30, 1,396 ft below the pass; points to May 22 to July 25

evidence.name: Bishop Pass
evidence.detail: melted out May 27, 376 ft below the pass; points to May 9 to June 27
